ALTER PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CustomerAccount_ATM
AS
BEGIN


--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount AS 
(
SELECT
	BAC.BAC_ID AS CustomerAccountId
	,NULL AS CustomerAccountName
	,BAC.BAC_CREATED_TS AS CustomerAccountOpenedDate
	,NULL AS CustomerAccountClosedDate
	,NULL AS GlobalServiceRelationshipNumber
	,BACL.CLT_CIF_NUMBER AS CustomerId
	,NULL AS ResponsibilityCenterId
	,NULL AS SubaccountOfCustomerAccountId
	,NULL AS LedgerId
	,NULL AS LedgerAccountNumber
	,BAC.BAC_CUR_ID AS IsoCurrencyCode
	,NULL AS CustomerAccountTypeId
	,NULL AS CustomerAccountApplicationNumber
	,NULL AS Last6AccountNumber
	,NULL AS CustomerAccountShortName
	,BAC.BAC_BRN_ID AS BranchId
	,'ATM' AS SourceSystemCode
	,BAC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,NULL AS VerifiedIndicator
	,NULL AS DeletedIndicator
	,NULL AS AccountPrefix
	,NULL AS CustomerAccountNote
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,BAC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
	,BACD.RECORD_STATUS
FROM BUSC.ATM_CASHBANKACCOUNT_DELTA BACD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.ATM_CASHBANKACCOUNT BAC ON BACD.BAC_ID = BAC.BAC_ID AND ISNULL(BACD.BAC_UUID,'') = ISNULL(BAC.BAC_UUID,'') AND BAC.ISLATEST = 1
LEFT JOIN BUSC.ATM_CLIENT BACL ON BACL.CLT_ID = BAC.BAC_CLT_ID AND BAC.ISLATEST = 1


UNION

SELECT
	BAC.CAC_ID AS CustomerAccountId
	,NULL AS CustomerAccountName
	,BAC.CAC_CREATED_TS AS CustomerAccountOpenedDate
	,NULL AS CustomerAccountClosedDate
	,NULL AS GlobalServiceRelationshipNumber
	,BACL.CLT_CIF_NUMBER AS CustomerId
	,NULL AS ResponsibilityCenterId
	,NULL AS SubaccountOfCustomerAccountId
	,NULL AS LedgerId
	,NULL AS LedgerAccountNumber
	,NULL AS IsoCurrencyCode
	,NULL AS CustomerAccountTypeId
	,NULL AS CustomerAccountApplicationNumber
	,NULL AS Last6AccountNumber
	,NULL AS CustomerAccountShortName
	,BAC.CAC_BRN_ID AS BranchId
	,'ATM' AS SourceSystemCode
	,BAC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,NULL AS VerifiedIndicator
	,NULL AS DeletedIndicator
	,NULL AS AccountPrefix
	,NULL AS CustomerAccountNote
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,BAC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
	,BACD.RECORD_STATUS
FROM BUSC.ATM_CASHCARDACCOUNT_DELTA BACD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.ATM_CASHCARDACCOUNT BAC ON BACD.CAC_ID = BAC.CAC_ID AND ISNULL(BACD.CAC_UUID,'') = ISNULL(BAC.CAC_UUID,'') AND BAC.ISLATEST = 1
LEFT JOIN BUSC.ATM_CLIENT BACL ON BACL.CLT_ID = BAC.CAC_CLT_ID AND BAC.ISLATEST = 1

)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerAccountId
,CustomerAccountOpenedDate
,CustomerId
,IsoCurrencyCode
,BranchId
,FinancialInstitutionId
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, RECORD_STATUS 
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerAccountId
,CustomerAccountOpenedDate
,CustomerId
,IsoCurrencyCode
,BranchId
,FinancialInstitutionId
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount --WHERE SOURCE_CODE = 'ATM'	
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId,TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_TGT	TGT
ON	convert(varchar,SRC.CustomerAccountId) = convert(varchar,TGT.CustomerAccountId)
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_DELTA;

---------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
	CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId
	,CustomerAccountName = NULL
	,CustomerAccountOpenedDate = SRC.CustomerAccountOpenedDate
	,CustomerAccountClosedDate = NULL
	,GlobalServiceRelationshipNumber = NULL
	,CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId
	,ResponsibilityCenterId = NULL
	,SubaccountOfCustomerAccountId = NULL
	,LedgerId = NULL
	,LedgerAccountNumber = NULL
	,IsoCurrencyCode = SRC.IsoCurrencyCode
	,CustomerAccountTypeId = NULL
	,CustomerAccountApplicationNumber = NULL
	,Last6AccountNumber = NULL
	,CustomerAccountShortName = NULL
	,BranchId = SRC.BranchId
	,SourceSystemCode = 'ATM'
	,FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
	,DeleteIndicator = NULL
	,CustomerAccountNote = NULL
	,WorkFlowId = 0
	,TaskRunId = 0
	,InsertDttm = SRC.InsertDttm
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_DELTA DELTA ON convert(varchar,DELTA.CustomerAccountId) = convert(varchar,TGT.CustomerAccountId)  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount SRC ON convert(varchar,SRC.CustomerAccountId) = convert(varchar,TGT.CustomerAccountId) ;

 
-------INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccount
(
	CustomerAccountId
	,CustomerAccountName
	,CustomerAccountOpenedDate
	,CustomerAccountClosedDate
	,GlobalServiceRelationshipNumber
	,CustomerId
	,ResponsibilityCenterId
	,SubaccountOfCustomerAccountId
	,LedgerId
	,LedgerAccountNumber
	,IsoCurrencyCode
	,CustomerAccountTypeId
	,CustomerAccountApplicationNumber
	,Last6AccountNumber
	,CustomerAccountShortName
	,BranchId
	,SourceSystemCode
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	,DeleteIndicator
	,CustomerAccountNote
	,WorkFlowId
	,TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm
)
SELECT
	CustomerAccountId
	,NULL AS CustomerAccountName
	,CustomerAccountOpenedDate
	,NULL AS CustomerAccountClosedDate
	,NULL AS GlobalServiceRelationshipNumber
	,CustomerId
	,NULL AS ResponsibilityCenterId
	,NULL AS SubaccountOfCustomerAccountId
	,NULL AS LedgerId
	,NULL AS LedgerAccountNumber
	,IsoCurrencyCode
	,NULL AS CustomerAccountTypeId
	,NULL AS CustomerAccountApplicationNumber
	,NULL AS Last6AccountNumber
	,NULL AS CustomerAccountShortName
	,BranchId
	,'ATM' AS SourceSystemCode
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	,NULL AS DeleteIndicator
	,NULL AS CustomerAccountNote
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount
WHERE RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_DELTA;


END
